PFC and REC Boards Approve Merger, Creating Power Financing Giant

The boards of Power Finance Corporation (PFC) and REC Ltd have approved a merger scheme, creating a significant entity in the power sector financing landscape. The combined loan book is expected to exceed ₹11 lakh crore. REC shareholders will receive 88 PFC shares for every 100 REC shares held as part of the approved share swap ratio.
